title: For molecules containing double bonds with oxygen atoms, calculate the perc
question: For molecules containing double bonds with oxygen atoms, calculate the percentage that are carcinogenic and count the total number of distinct elements present in these molecules.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '=' AND a.XCL_003 = 'o'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS percentage_carcinogenic,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS total_distinct_elements
FROM eligible_molecules em
JOIN molecule m ON em.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '=' AND a.XCL_003 = 'o'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS percentage_carcinogenic,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS total_distinct_elements
FROM eligible_molecules em
JOIN molecule m ON em.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002

Join eligible molecules back to molecule to preserve one row per molecule for the carcinogenic percentage denominator.

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '=' AND a.XCL_003 = 'o'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS percentage_carcinogenic,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS total_distinct_elements
FROM eligible_molecules em
JOIN molecule m ON em.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1."XCL_011" = '+' THEN T1."XCL_010" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_010")
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1."XCL_010" = T2."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_002"
WHERE T2."XCL_006" = '=' AND T3."XCL_003" = 'o'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS percentage_carcinogenic,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a1.XCL_003) + COUNT(DISTINCT a2.XCL_003) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.XCL_003 = a2.XCL_003 THEN a1.XCL_003 END) AS total_distinct_elements
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
JOIN connected c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
JOIN connected c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009
JOIN atom a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
JOIN atom a2 ON c2.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
  AND (a1.XCL_003 = 'o' OR a2.XCL_003 = 'o')
